source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Brakes, p.5-24

procedures.title: Disc brakes: bleeding
steps: Never reuse brake fluid drained from the system.
notes: The plunger hold-open step for the front pressure regulator valve applies to Chevrolet, Chevelle, Camaro and Chevy II only.

procedures.title: Parking brake (Corvette): adjust
steps: Put the car on a hoist.
Slacken the cables at the equalizer until the parking brake levers return freely to off with slack in the cables.
Turn the disc until the adjusting screw shows through the hole in the disc.
Put an adjusting tool or screwdriver through the hole and tighten the adjusting screw by moving the handle away from the floor, on both left and right sides (see figure 37 in the manual).
Tighten until the disc will not turn, then back off 6 to 8 notches.
From inside the car, apply the parking brake 2 notches.
Tighten the cables at the equalizer for a light drag with the wheels mounted.
Release the handle fully and spin the rear wheels; there must be no drag.
